column1: # Alex stops the party in Mogall Forest and unsettles Mia.

column3: Slow down, Isaac. This\nforest eats the careless.{end_wait}
Alex, why do you keep\nturning up ahead of us?{end_wait}
Because I know where this\nroad ends. Ask the blade's\ndaughter, since she knows{page_break}too.{end_wait}
You speak too freely,\nsmuggler. Know your place.{end_wait}
There it is, the voice that\nisn't hers. It's old and\nvery hungry.{end_wait}
Isaac, what's he talking\nabout? What voice?{end_wait}
Ask her. I'll be waiting in\nthe mountains, so hurry.{end_wait}
